propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map use unpaginated search_issues calls that default to max_results=50, silently truncating projects with more than 50 issues
the differ emits spurious link-creation mutations and cannot detect removals when issue links are missing due to truncation
search_issues defaults to max_results=50 and does not raise an error or warning when truncating results, allowing failures to pass silently

all three whole-project readers (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map, get_parent_map) must be refactored to use a shared _paged_search helper that advances by len(batch) and terminates only on empty pages
get_parent_map already implements correct pagination logic (proven in change 1105) and must be included in the refactor to avoid drift and prevent future unpaginated callers
